scope: Ordinary-client read-only task and approval APIs with real temporary PostgreSQL and synthetic identities
verificationTiming: The full suite passed immediately before committing these unchanged runtime files

beforeImplementation.failure: HTTP 404 TARGET_NOT_FOUND for the missing routes

tasks.visibility: Authenticated tenant and live authorized scopes; filtered before LIMIT

approvals.history: All task records including earlier input revisions

assertions: Default 20, minimum 1 and maximum 100 with more than 100 visible persisted tasks
Limits 0, -1, 101, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, abc and an empty limit fail with INVALID_PAYLOAD
Newer hidden-scope and other-tenant tasks are excluded before limiting
Authorized peer-created tasks remain readable and input changes do not reorder creation time
TaskView includes current revisions, capability metadata and pending requests
Only tasks.read is sufficient; admin and approval-write permissions remain independent
Scope removal and read-grant revocation apply to existing tokens
Approval records retain original shape, earlier revisions, open/approved/declined statuses and nullable approvedBy
Cross-scope and cross-tenant approval reads fail with FORBIDDEN_SCOPE
Approval GET does not create decisions or change approval and task-event counts
Existing graceful restart regressions and mindmap HTTP/worker compatibility pass in the full suite
